cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: Home of the Opera House and Harbour Bridge, with harbourside walks and Bondi beach a short ride away.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Australia's arts capital, known for laneway coffee, street art and a riverside skyline that lights up at night.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A city of neon crossings and quiet shrines, where Mount Fuji shows itself over the skyline on clear days.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: The old imperial capital, famous for wooden machiya houses, tea gardens and the torii tunnels of Fushimi Inari.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Framed by granite peaks and the Atlantic, with Christ the Redeemer watching over the bay from Corcovado.

cities.name: Sao Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: South America's largest city and its cultural engine, with world-class museums, markets and restaurants.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: The largest religious monument on earth, best seen at sunrise when the towers double in the reflecting pool.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: A white marble mausoleum in Agra, built by Shah Jahan for Mumtaz Mahal and mirrored in its long reflecting pool.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A volcanic island ringed by a turquoise lagoon, known for overwater bungalows and clear snorkelling water.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: Four kilometres of sand curving through Rio de Janeiro, busy with football, beach vendors and evening crowds.
